verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a collaboration platform like Teams, but the evidence pack documents no batch or bulk-action capability. The Graph API automation docs (creating teams, channels, posting single messages) are developer building blocks, not a bulk-operations feature. The Export APIs describe exporting chat content but never describe acting on many items at once, so they are adjacent at best.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
